parsed.explanation: Worst documented features sit at tier 2: state-tolerated targeting. Police stopped and documented ~20 trans women (Aug 2025); 2025 saw 299 detention decisions (43 off-record), 313 violations, ~2.5x 2024. State response is damning: a knifed trans woman was referred for arrest while her attacker was released; a trans prisoner's Dec 2025 death saw delayed investigation and no witness statements. Custody is severe: segregation, strip searches, isolation, ineffective complaints, no LGBT-trained staff. Official rhetoric actively stigmatises, raids target LGBT organisations, and no non-discrimination law exists. The ID-carry rule initiates police contact. Mitigating: no presentation offence in force (the advocacy bill failed), no executions, detainees released after checks, no documented border/transit targeting of trans visitors, visitors can arrange HRT privately. Patterned, state-linked, unremedied—but below organised criminalisation tier.
